x.paused_reason: owner_decision_2026-08-29: "im not funding X so find a $0 workaround or kill it." This is NOT a dormant pause: X is off for API POSTING only, and distribution continues through the delivery route below. That is what pause_mode "delivery_route" means and why it is not "dormant" like LinkedIn. It used to mean a sheet the owner worked through herself; that was retired on 2026-08-29 when she said "this means i manually have to do it? i will never do it honestly", and Buffer replaced it entirely. Nothing in this repository asks her to do anything now.
